newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Regal Cinemas cut to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Regal Cinemas cut to hold.

text.p: -- Hilliard Lyons said Thursday it lowered its rating on Regal Cinemas to hold from buy.
-- cited substantial price appreciation over the last several months.
-- Analyst Jeffrey Thomison in a report said the benefits of the successful holiday film season so far are mostly reflected in Regal Cinemas's current stock price.
-- He said the outlook for the company and the industry appears favorable.
-- The stock of Regal Cinemas, a motion picture exhibiter, was trading at 33, up 1/8.
